notes.title: Gex Trilogy Update 2
notes.content:
Thank you for your support of [b]Gex Trilogy[/b], the latest patch is live now and addresses the following issues.

[list]
[*] Corrected further audio errors for some users.
[*] Added end-of-level save game prompts.
[/list]

notes.title: Gex Trilogy Update
notes.content:
Thank you for your support of [b]Gex Trilogy[/b], the latest patch is live now and addresses the following issues.

[list]
[*] Keyboard key remapping has been added to the options menu
[*] Addressed a startup issue for some users
[*] Corrected in-game audio errors for some users
[*] Updated credits
[/list]

Please direct any additional feedback to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3183970/discussions/0/528723987504607585/]Steam Support Thread[/url]. Thank you for playing [b]Gex Trilogy[/b]!

notes.title: PAL Versions Added!
notes.content: [h1][i]Thank you for making the launch of GEX Trilogy a huge success![/i] [/h1][previewyoutube="tF8PQFvuN7Q;full"][/previewyoutube][p]It’s been in the works for a while and we’re finally able to announce that the PAL versions of [i]GEX 2 & GEX 3[/i], featuring the iconic voices of [b]Leslie Philips[/b] and [b]Danny John-Jules[/b], respectively, have been added to GEX Trilogy through an update! [/p][p]Once the update is downloaded and applied, you will be able to select the PAL versions on the menu by changing the regional flag to your preference before starting the game. Due to the fact that the NTSC and PAL versions of the game are completely separate game builds, please be aware that save data is not transferable between regional versions of the same game.[/p][p]We’re excited for European GEX fans to relive these games the way they remember and for others to hear these incredible voices for the first time![/p][p]In addition to the PAL versions, we have also re-mapped the default keyboard controls for the games.[/p][p]This update is being pushed live on Steam [b]right now[/b]![/p]

notes.title: GEX Trilogy is available now!
notes.content: [p]After years of anticipation, GEX Trilogy is now live on Steam. We are beyond excited for all of you to experience what we've been working on and hope you enjoy your return to these beloved classics![/p]

notes.title: GEX Trilogy Launches This Monday!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="X5_-uhPXNOo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]While you're waiting for GEX Trilogy to launch this Monday - check out the all-new episode of Carboncast that we've posted to YouTube to help highlight some of the work that has been put into this release. We're extremely proud of what we've built with GEX Trilogy and believe this is the best and most definitive way to experience these incredible games.[/p][p][/p][p]Please tell everyone you know that GEX is back - even people who will be completely and utterly confused by the mention of it. We want to make sure everyone knows this gecko is back and better than ever before![/p]

notes.title: A classic returns with the GEX Trilogy releasing on June 16
notes.content:
Limited Run Games have announced that the GEX Trilogy, an upgraded edition of three classic games, will arrive on June 16th.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/a-classic-returns-with-the-gex-trilogy-releasing-on-june-16/

notes.title: GEX Trilogy Releases June 16th!
notes.content:
We're excited to finally announce that GEX Trilogy will be available on June 16th, 2025!

In addition to revealing the game's release date, we've also announced that GEX 2 and GEX 3 will be playable in native widescreen with all-new analog control, letting you experience GEX like never before! Now that's what I call getting some tail!

We also revealed some new artwork by famed Japanese artist, Yoshitaka Amano! You might know him from his work on a lesser known Square Enix franchise, so it made sense to finally give him the opportunity to illustrate their best one - GEX!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482479/acdd6ce1970317a409868de7bb625d99b864fd51.png[/img]

Don't miss GEX Trilogy when it goes on sale on Monday, June 16th - wishlist it now!

notes.title: GEX Trilogy arrives this Summer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482479/aaeb50fb378ecfed1acc835a4de678a3d68330a6.png[/img]

Get ready to kick off the year of GEX in Summer 2025 by watching the all-new trailer that we just posted on the GEX Trilogy Steam page.

While we've teased release dates in the past, we mean it this time! GEX Trilogy will truly launch this Summer, allowing old and new fans alike the chance to revisit these three classic games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482479/16c5395f4b72d446f1a61d8de14fcf048e3e74b5.png[/img]
